simple.meaning: חָיָה (châyâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to live , whether literally or figuratively; causatively, to revive.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 265 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 4 more, beginning at Genesis 5:3. Its contexts include family, family line.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חָיָה (H2421).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: חָיָה (châyâh) / H2421 is traced through Genesis 5:3, Genesis 5:6, Genesis 5:7, Genesis 5:9 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.short: to live , whether literally or figuratively; causatively, to revive
